mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with three consecutive months of declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0% for three consecutive months, it signals tightening monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 2.0% for 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment (UNRATE) signal robust labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with PAYEMS up and UNRATE down, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand and potential economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle periods with HOUST decline, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate trend over three consecutive months indicates deteriorating labor conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with three consecutive months of rising UNRATE, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 110 for three consecutive months, it signals supply-side overheating that may trigger monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO > 110 for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal broad-based demand contraction across key sectors, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with HOUST and RSAFS both declining, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY), rising CPI signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of high-inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.
